Scrapes a simple HTML page and extracts title, description, and links

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "crawlberg"
engine_config = { 'max_depth' => 0, 'respect_robots_txt' => false }
engine = Crawlberg.create_engine(engine_config.to_json)
url = 'https://example.com'
result = Crawlberg.scrape(engine, url)
puts result.status_code.inspect
puts result.content_type.inspect
puts result.html.inspect
puts result.metadata.title.inspect
puts result.metadata.description.inspect
puts result.metadata.canonical_url.inspect
puts result.links.length.inspect
puts result.links[0].link_type.inspect
puts result.images.length.inspect
puts result.metadata.og_title.inspect
```
